text: In the early hours of the twentieth of June, eighteen hundred and thirty-seven, two men drove through the dark from Windsor to Kensington Palace. Victoria herself tells us what happened next, in her journal. She was woken at six o'clock by her mother, and told that the Archbishop of Canterbury and Lord Conyngham wished to see her. She went into her sitting room, in her dressing gown, and alone. There she was told that her uncle the King was no more, and that she was Queen. She was eighteen years old.
